title: BetterKeybinds
description: BetterHotbar displays the actual keybind for each hotbar slot directly on the slot — no more guessing which key is assigned where.
body:
# BetterKeybinds

**BetterKeybinds** displays your actual assigned keybind on each hotbar slot — small, clean, and always accurate.

---

## How it works

Vanilla Minecraft shows nothing on your hotbar slots. BetterKeybinds adds a small label in the top-right corner of each slot showing the exact key you have bound to it. Remapped your keys? No problem — it always reflects your actual keybinds.

---

## Features

- ✅ Displays actual keybind per hotbar slot
- ✅ Updates automatically when keybinds change
- ✅ Clean and minimal — no clutter
- ✅ Lightweight — no performance impact

---

*Client-side only — works on any server.*
